latestVersion.changelog:
Video Generator Free App — Initial Release

- Instantly create and export 1080p promo videos by uploading images or clips (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 200MB) and describing your desired output.
- Designed for TikTok creators who want ready-to-post videos without paid editing tools or manual adjustments.
- Free 7-day credit system with anonymous access; supports rapid file uploads and session-based work.
- Automatic AI video generation, music/text overlay, and cloud rendering; typical turnaround is 30-90 seconds.
- Handles uploads, edits, and exports through a streamlined chat-driven workflow.
- Clear error handling, real-time status updates, and simple export/download process.
